question: are the gen1 per-swath dx/dy/dz constants samples of one continuous mission-time drift, or per-flight-line quantities that gps_time merely correlates with?

params.name: min_pts
params.why: coreg.fit_along_track_drift default; used for a SECONDARY disclosure row only

params.name: swath_reference
params.why: pipeline.difference_dem calls align_swaths(ref=int(ps8.min())) -- that swath's (dx,dy,dz) is pinned to zero and is NOT an observation

columns.site: study site = one gen1 tile/merge processed by scripts/run_all_sites.py
columns.swath: point_source_id (flight line) in the gen1 file
columns.n_file: returns of that swath in the whole gen1 file (the extent align_swaths saw)
columns.n_grid: returns of that swath inside the analysis bounds (what the drift fit saw)
columns.t_mid: mean gps_time of the swath over the whole file, s (raw file units)
columns.span_s: t_max - t_min of the swath over the whole file, s
columns.gap_s: elapsed gps_time from the previous swath's t_mid, s (time order)
columns.dx_m: saved per-swath alignment East shift, m (added to gen1 x)
columns.dy_m: saved per-swath alignment North shift, m (added to gen1 y)
columns.dz_mm: saved per-swath alignment vertical shift, mm (added to gen1 z)
columns.hdg_deg: flight heading from a least-squares fit of x(t), y(t), deg clockwise from North
columns.axis: which of dz / dx / dy / across-track / along-track is being regressed
columns.nsw: number of swaths entering the fit (reference swath excluded unless stated)
columns.r: Pearson correlation of the axis against gps_time across swaths
columns.slope_per_h: ordinary-least-squares slope against gps_time, mm/hour (dz) or m/hour (dx,dy)
columns.r_incl_ref: same Pearson r with the forced-zero reference swath INCLUDED
columns.R2_time: R-squared of a 2-parameter fit linear in elapsed gps_time
columns.R2_ordinal: R-squared of a 2-parameter fit linear in flight-line ordinal (time order)
columns.cv_per_h: coefficient of variation of the consecutive-pair step expressed PER HOUR
columns.cv_per_line: coefficient of variation of the same steps expressed PER LINE
columns.pair: consecutive pair of swaths in time order
columns.d_dz_mm: dz of the later swath minus dz of the earlier, mm
columns.rate_mm_h: d_dz_mm divided by the elapsed gap, mm/hour
columns.pred_mm: step the site's own fitted continuous rate predicts over that gap, mm
columns.dow: GPS day of week of the swath midpoint (0 = Sunday); only defined for week-seconds files
columns.date_utc: UTC date from adjusted-standard gps_time; blank where the file stores week-seconds
columns.t_mid_elba: elba mean gps_time for that swath, in-grid, s
columns.t_mid_ext: elbaext mean gps_time for the SAME swath, in-grid, s
columns.disagree_mm: elbaext dz minus elba dz for the same swath, both re-referenced to swath 135, mm
columns.need_mm_s: mm/s of drift that would be required for dt_s to explain disagree_mm
columns.gps_time_type: LAS global encoding bit 0: 0 = GPS week seconds, 1 = adjusted standard GPS time

headline: mission-time drift: correlation vs gap-structure test across 7 gen1 sites
